title: Song about the wild rose blossoms on the little green place
html_source:
Here, he’s referring to the little song his father was singing at the opening of the chapter.
“O, the wild rose blossoms
On the little green place”
These lyrics are a slightly altered part of the song “Lilly Dale,” an 1852 song by H.S. Thompson, about a young maiden felled by disease. It is significant that he would reference the song as the title fits well with all the discussion around lavender and roses, but the part about disease is also telling. Is it foreshadowing? Is it ironic?

Here’s a rendition of the full song
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VVfjIM3gMtE
